catalogue.note: A node-for-node copy of the modular dashboard: the two Figma renders differ by 15 antialiased pixels and every asset matches after normalising, so the build is regenerated from it with this frame’s node ids. The hamburger is the instance’s own vector in Dark #292929; the icon-level export still carries the main component’s navy. The 21px title and the 16px figures move down 1px: a measured correction, not a Figma value.
